verdict.rationale: Zep documents granular deletion. Deleting a User removes all associated threads and artifacts in a single API call, which it positions for Right To Be Forgotten and privacy compliance. Deleting a node cascades to its connected edges, and individual edges can be deleted via `client.graph.edge.delete`. zepctl also exposes data operations from the terminal, and a your-VPC deployment option gives control over where data resides. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies or automatic TTL/expiry windows, and independent or hands-on confirmation that deletions are complete.
